title: Peptlas open data: peptide regulatory status by jurisdiction
description:
The regulatory status of peptides and related compounds under the U.S. FDA, Australia (TGA), the UK (MHRA), the EU (EMA), Health Canada and WADA, in a five-state taxonomy (compounding-legal, under review, in limbo, restricted, unscheduled), with a dated regulatory events log, FDA advisory committee votes and a source bibliography. Every row is verified by hand against primary regulator sources.

Always-current version: https://peptlas.com/peptide-status-by-country/. Informational only; not medical or legal advice.
